strings.zh: 什么？我才是第一个到的！{SCROLL}为了能在战斗前线排在第一位,{CLEAR}我连觉也没睡就排在这儿了。{SCROLL}你要是愿意排到第２的话{NEWLINE}就排在我的后面吧！{SCROLL}
strings.en: What? I’m the one who got here first!{SCROLL}To be first in line at the Battle{NEWLINE}Frontier, I didn’t even sleep. I’ve been{CLEAR}standing in line right here.{SCROLL}If you don’t mind being second, get in{NEWLINE}line behind me!{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0745/0 | RV043: addition: dropped US 'days' and the unopened-Frontier line (D-2024)

strings.zh: 呼呼……　……{NEWLINE}……　……　……{SCROLL}这个人{NEWLINE}站着就睡着了！{SCROLL}

strings.en: Zzz... Zzz...{NEWLINE}...{SCROLL}You can’t wake him up at all!
strings.notes: US 0745/2 | RV043: meaning: 完全叫不醒 (D-2024)

strings.zh: 我只有6枚徽章,{NEWLINE}不知道应不应付得来这里的战斗。
strings.en: I only have six Badges. I don’t know{NEWLINE}if I can handle the battles here.

strings.zh: 前面是战斗前线,{NEWLINE}想要提升对战技巧的训练家们{CLEAR}都会来这里锻炼。
strings.en: Up ahead is the Battle Frontier.{NEWLINE}Trainers who want to improve their{CLEAR}battle skills all come here to train.

strings.zh: 为了应对与火箭队的决战,{NEWLINE}战斗前线的训练家们{CLEAR}也都在紧张地准备着。{CLEAR}请冠军大人放心！
strings.en: The Trainers at the Battle{NEWLINE}Frontier are busy getting ready{CLEAR}for the final showdown with Team{CLEAR}Rocket. Rest assured, Champion!
